name: tienkung_vla_collect_data
description: A VLA data collection pipeline for the Tienkung 2.0 PRO robot with homomorphic-arm teleoperation, supporting Inspire Robots 6-DOF dexterous hands and EG2-4C2 electric grippers, three-view RGB cameras (Orbbec L335 head camera and Intel RealSense D405 wrist cameras), and direct conversion to LeRobot datasets for VLA or world-model training.
